|rulings=* Reducing retrieval reduces X on [[Secret Plans (Defensive Shield){{!}}Secret Plans]].<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Do%20They%20Have%20A%20Code%20Clearance%3F Scomp: Do They Have A Code Clearance? (Defensive Shield)]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* Retrieving a specific card can be reduced from 1 card retrieved to 0.
* Code Clearance stacks an Interrupt after it retrieves Force. By this time, the Interrupt could already have been stacked on another grabber (e.g. [[Allegations Of Corruption]]) first, in which case it remains on that first grabber.
* Code Clearance can stack an Interrupt before [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough{{!}}This Place Can Be A Little Rough]] can place it out of play.
* [[Outrider]] places Utinni Effects out of play before Code Clearance can stack.
* DS cards such as [[You Swindled Me!]] may be stacked.
